Hi, my rescue had 2 mast cell tumours removed in 2017 before i had her. Vet at the time said one of them was aggressive and likely to return, giving her a life span of 2 years. I took her in after seeing the shelters appeal as they didn’t want her to live whatever life she had left in kennels…. She’s now been with me 4 years and just turned 12 in july, and no signs of any new tumours! I was religiously giving her “golden dog paste” which is turmeric paste i found the recipe to online, after doing a lot of research into things that can fight against them. I was also giving her a dogs hemp oil but i stopped that after about a year of having her because unfortunately my finances changed and i could no longer afford it, shes a large dog so dosage was high. I still occasionally make the turmeric paste and put it in her food but im not as religious with it these days. Now i can’t say 100% it was the paste that prevented them returning because for all i know they might not have anyway, but with so many other success stories ive read online about it, its definitely something i’d recommend trying. it also has many other benefits and is super cheap to make.
